title: 第117章 小道消息二合一第116章 这是何物
slug: 不是吧这魔修过于正义
content_zh:
赵日天有些局促。
上周林竹提出让他假扮男友的事。
他犹豫再三，终归还是答应了。
一方面出于同事之谊，另一方面则出于他小小的私心。
万一林竹真相亲成功了……
那个画面他不敢想。
包厢里的冷气开得很足，可赵日天的额头上却在疯狂往外冒汗。
他坐在红木圆桌前，双手无处安放，只能死死攥着桌布，接着又疯狂地在裤腿上蹭着手汗。
这已经是他在五分钟内第十八次拿起手机看时间，外加第二十次借着黑屏检查自己的发型了。
“冷静……赵日天，稳住，不就是假扮个男朋友吗？我们能赢……”
他小声嘟囔着给自己疯狂洗脑，可右腿却像是踩了个隐形的缝纫机，抖得连带着整张大圆桌上的茶杯都在跟着微微震颤。
太紧张了。
这可是见家长啊！
万一露馅了怎么办？
赵日天有个从小到大都改不掉的毛病。
压力爆表的时候，总想发出点什么怪异的动静来释放情绪。
以前在公司遇到大考评是这样，现在这种“生死存亡”的关头，更是憋到了极点。
他环顾了一圈空无一人的包厢，深吸了一口气，终于按捺不住体内那股乱窜的洪荒之力。
他闭上眼，仰起脖子，对着天花板发出了极其狂野的一嗓子：“嗷呜——！嗷嗷嗷——咕嘎！！！”
“吱呀——”

就在这时，包厢那扇厚重的实木门，被人从外面推开了。
空气。
在这一瞬间，陷入了死一般的寂静。
赵日天呆住了。
门外，林竹的手还保持着推门的动作。
而在林竹的身后，站着一对中年夫妇。
林父穿着一件熨烫得没有一丝褶皱的深色polo衫，鼻梁上架着一副无框眼镜，原本充满上位者威严的脸庞，此刻完全扭曲了。
他瞪着两只眼睛，嘴角剧烈地抽搐着，那表情活像是推门进错了片场，不小心撞见了一场珍稀灵长类动物的返祖仪式。
林母则是盘着精致的头发，穿着一身优雅的素色旗袍，气质温婉富态。
只是此刻，她那精心描绘的柳叶眉也高高地挑了起来，端着手提包的手僵在半空，眼神中闪烁着三分震惊、三分迷茫和四分“我女儿是不是找了个傻子”的深切怀疑。
时间仿佛停滞了一个世纪。
赵日天觉得自己的灵魂已经出窍，飘在天花板上给自己唱起了安魂曲。
这哪里是假扮男友，这分明是一场蓄谋已久的顶级社死！
就在场面极度尴尬之时。
林母极其自然地走进了包厢，脸上还挂着温婉的笑容：“小赵这是在练开嗓呢？怎么，打算待会儿吃饭的时候，给叔叔阿姨高歌一曲助助兴？这精气神儿，可比现在那些天天死气沉沉抱着手机的年轻人强太多啦！”
林竹一边挽住老妈的胳膊，一边疯狂给赵日天使眼色：“哈……哈哈，对！妈您眼光真准！他平时没别的爱好，就喜欢练练美声，最近正在挑战海豚音呢……刚刚那就是在找共鸣腔！”
“哦，找共鸣腔啊，挺好，年轻人有爱好是好事，比天天窝在家里打游戏强。”
林母笑眯眯地点了点头。
几人开始落座。
赵日天这辈子都没觉得餐厅的椅子这么烫屁股过。

他原本想表现得绅士一点，主动去给二老拉椅子，结果因为肢体太过僵硬，差点跟同样准备入座的林父撞个满怀。
两人在桌边极其诡异地互相谦让着扭动了两下，赵日天最后只能像个圆规一样，尴尬地退回了自己的座位上。
一屁股坐下后，赵日天的双手彻底成了多余的器官。
他先是将两只手规规矩矩地平放在膝盖上，腰杆挺得笔直，活脱脱一个准备听班主任训话的小学生。
过了两秒，他觉得这样显得太呆板，又把手拿上来，交叉相扣放在桌面上，两只大拇指开始在手背上疯狂地玩起了互搏。
content_en:
Zhao Ritian was a little embarrassed.
Last week Lin Zhu asked him to pretend to be her boyfriend.
He hesitated again and again, but finally agreed.
On the one hand, it is out of friendship as a colleague, and on the other hand, it is out of his small selfishness.
What if Lin Zhu really succeeds in getting married...
He didn't dare to think about that scene.
The air conditioner in the private room was turned on very high, but Zhao Ritian was sweating crazily on his forehead.
He sat in front of the mahogany round table, with nowhere to place his hands. He could only hold the tablecloth tightly, and then frantically wiped the sweat from his hands on his trouser legs.
This is already the eighteenth time in five minutes that he has picked up his phone to check the time, and the twentieth time he has used the black screen to check his hairstyle.
"Calm down...Zhao Ritian, hold on, aren't you just pretending to be a boyfriend? We can win..."
He muttered in a low voice to brainwash himself crazily, but his right leg seemed to have stepped on an invisible sewing machine, shaking so much that even the teacups on the large round table were shaking slightly.
Too nervous.
This is a meeting with parents!
What if the secret is exposed?
Zhao Ritian has a problem that he has been unable to get rid of since he was a child.
When the pressure is overwhelming, I always want to make some weird noise to release my emotions.
I used to be like this when I faced big evaluations in the company, but now at this "life and death" moment, I was even more depressed to the extreme.
He looked around at the empty box, took a deep breath, and finally couldn't hold back the wild power rushing through his body.
He closed his eyes, raised his neck, and let out an extremely wild voice at the ceiling: "Ouch! Ouch! Ouch! Goo!"
"Squeak——"
At this moment, the heavy solid wood door of the box was pushed open from the outside.
Air.
At this moment, it fell into deathly silence.
Zhao Ritian was stunned.
Outside the door, Lin Zhu's hand still kept pushing the door.
Behind Lin Zhu, stood a middle-aged couple.
Father Lin was wearing a dark polo shirt that was ironed without a trace of wrinkles, and a pair of rimless glasses on the bridge of his nose. His face, which was originally filled with the majesty of a superior, was completely distorted at this moment.
His eyes were wide open and the corners of his mouth were twitching violently. His expression was as if he had opened the door and entered the wrong set and accidentally stumbled into an atavistic ritual of rare primates.
Mother Lin has her delicate hair tied up in a bun and an elegant plain cheongsam, with a gentle and elegant temperament.
But at this moment, her carefully painted willow eyebrows were raised high, the hand holding the handbag was frozen in the air, and her eyes were filled with three parts shock, three parts confusion and four parts deep suspicion of "Did my daughter find a fool?"
Time seemed to have stood still for a century.
Zhao Ritian felt that his soul had left his body and was floating on the ceiling singing a requiem to himself.
This is not pretending to be a boyfriend, this is clearly a long-planned top-level social death!
Just when the situation was extremely embarrassing.
Mother Lin walked into the box very naturally, with a gentle smile on her face: "Is Xiao Zhao practicing his voice? Why, are you planning to sing a song for your uncle and aunt during dinner later? This spirit is much better than those young people today who are lifeless and holding mobile phones every day!"
Lin Zhu held his mother's arm and gave Zhao Richang a crazy wink: "Ha...haha, yes! Mom, you have such a good vision! He has no other hobbies, he just likes to practice bel canto, and he is currently challenging the dolphin voice... He was just looking for a resonant cavity!"
"Oh, it's good to find a sympathetic voice. It's a good thing for young people to have hobbies. It's better than staying at home and playing games every day."
Mother Lin nodded with a smile.
Several people began to sit down.
Zhao Ritian has never felt that the chairs in the restaurant have been so hot to his buttocks in his life.
He originally wanted to behave like a gentleman and took the initiative to pull a chair for the second elder, but because his limbs were too stiff, he almost bumped into Father Lin, who was also about to take a seat.
The two of them twisted around the table in a very strange way, giving in to each other.After two clicks, Zhao Ritian could only act like a compass and retreat to his seat in embarrassment.
After sitting down, Zhao Ritian's hands became completely redundant organs.
He first placed his hands flat on his knees in an orderly manner, with his waist straight, just like a primary school student who was ready to listen to the class teacher's instructions.
After two seconds, he felt that this seemed too dull, so he took his hand up again, interlocked it and placed it on the table, and his two thumbs began to play with each other crazily on the back of his hand.
